context: Mrs. Mori invites Yumiko to a small ikebana class.
purpose: Elder friends sharing cultural craft together.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.style: Warm, curious lean-in. Soft fondness in the voice. The gentle probe of someone who's watched many people discover this. Unhurried, inviting.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Yes. I'm honestly nervous about it.
lines.style: Breath catches slightly on the admission. Soft and honest, almost surprised at her own confession. Warm underneath — the vulnerability of trying something new.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: Flowers — you work with each one carefully, one at a time.
lines.style: Steady, patient teacher's voice. Slow demonstration in the words themselves. The reassurance of someone who's taught this before and knows what matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: It's a beautiful tradition, isn't it.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. Soft wonder underneath — not performing awe, but genuinely touched. The voice of someone recognising something true.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: The mind settles, you know. It will.
lines.style: Knowing gentleness. Not forcing reassurance — just stating what she's seen happen. Warm and quiet, the wisdom of experience offered without weight.
